newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo to invest 650 mln Skr in car safety.
newsitem.headline: Volvo to invest 650 mln Skr in car safety.

text.p: Swedish automotive group AB Volvo said on Tuesday it would invest 650 million crowns in a car safety centre in Gothenburg in south western Sweden.
The first part of the car safety project will be in use in mid-1998, the company said in a statement.
"Anyone buying a Volvo expects that he or she will have one of the world's safest cars," said Stefan Nilsson, head of Volvo's car safety centre, in a statement.
"With the new plant we will see that we can meet expectations also in the future."
The current plant will be modernised and expanded and a new plant will be built, the company said.
